en.topic_title: University of Hong Kong law school dean says he may reconsider suspension of human rights in China course
en.topic_summary:
University of Hong Kong (HKU) students who enrolled in a human rights in China elective were told this week that it had been cancelled. However, the course professor – who is also the law school dean – has told HKFP he may rethink the suspension.
